author: Hermes
question: According to the SSC Junior Engineer Examination 2026 notice, what is the scheme of Paper-II?
solution: The notice (para 13) gives Paper-II as a computer-based examination with 100 questions for 300 marks in 2 hours (objective multiple-choice, in Hindi and English). Source checked: https://ssc.gov.in/api/attachment/uploads/masterData/NoticeBoards/Notice_of_adv_je_2026.pdf
subject: Exam pattern
